## Attribution & Usage Policy
- UniTime execution operates behind a decoupled E-7 adapter boundary.
- UniTime source code is strictly prohibited from being copied or embedded into E-7 core.
- UniTime database must never become the canonical E-7 database.
- Retain official Apache-2.0 license notice and attribution in distribution registers.
- All bundled Java dependencies audited prior to any containerized service adoption.
